notes: Documented the Karst+ MK2 (HDMI 2.0) SKU. A second SKU, Karst+ MK2 (DP 1.2), is identical except its 2 Production Outputs are DP 1.2 instead of HDMI 2.0 (Control Outputs stay 1x DP1.2 + 1x HDMI2.0 on both). No video-capture inputs are standard: the unit has a single optional capture-card slot (choices: AV-SDI, Dual DVI-SL, Dual 3G-SDI, Quad 3G-SDI, or Dual HDMI 2.0), all marked "Optional" in Green Hippo's own comparison table, so none are listed as ports here. Also optional (not included): dedicated LTC timecode input and an additional 10GbE network port. No DMX512 port exists; show control is via the dual 1GbE ports (Art-Net/sACN/MANet), USB (MIDI/Stream Deck), the ZooKeeper software UI, or REST API. Front-panel "USB 3.1" port speed (Gen1 vs Gen2) is not specified by the manufacturer, so 5Gbps was assumed. Physical size: 2U, 600mm deep (630mm w/ ears), 425mm wide (480mm w/ ears), 16kg.
